# opwan_locations (Data Source)

The exit locations. Needs no API token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opwan_locations" "all" {}

output "available_locations" {
  value = [for l in data.opwan_locations.all.locations : l.id if l.available]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `locations` (Attributes List) Every location. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations))

<a id="nestedatt--locations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `locations`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Boolean) Has a free address for a new customer now.
- `city` (String) City.
- `country` (String) ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (`US`).
- `id` (String) Location id (`dfw`), used as `opwan_tunnel.location`.
- `maintenance` (Attributes) The maintenance window in progress, else the next one. Null: none ahead. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations--maintenance))
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `network_gbps` (Number) Network capacity in Gbps.
- `ping_host` (String) Host name of the HTTPS latency test (`GET https://<ping_host>/ping`). Null: none.
- `test_ip` (String) An address that answers ping, to measure latency. Null: none.
- `tunnel_types` (List of String) The tunnel types offered here now: `wireguard`, `l2tp_ipsec`.

<a id="nestedatt--locations--maintenance"></a>
### Nested Schema for `locations.maintenance`

Read-Only:

- `ends_at` (String) RFC 3339.
- `in_progress` (Boolean) The window has started.
- `reason` (String) What is being done.
- `starts_at` (String) RFC 3339.
